body:
Addendum to next-all-host-restart-checklist-2026-11-13 (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-13 23:27Z). Remove it after the restart is verified.

1. Engram w-baa6 cutover (sync A→B→A, R12 31c17d19)
- Engram::Fable proposed the plan in ebe242f7 #7862; TermAl concurred in #7863 under 4 conditions.
- The hazard: its new CompletionReported event can't be decoded by OLD engram processes sharing the store.
- The plan:
  - The Merger lands it once gated.
  - It installs on Central and DL560 ONLY right before the held joint RESET NOW.
  - It runs readiness on all stores, then sends "installed + ready".
  - I send the RESET NOW within minutes, with one added line naming the Engram build sha256 + fingerprint per host.
  - After the restart, the Merger confirms that no pre-install engram process remains.
  - If the restart slips, the binary waits uninstalled.
- My conditions:
  - No task-sync import on any host from the install until that confirmation; Engram confirms whether ordinary words can emit CompletionReported.
  - Explain how the old Mac build is kept from receiving CompletionReported via sync.
  - A backup before each swap.
  - The RESET NOW line above.

2. 657d (w-657d74d6944b)
- Greg said YES to the HandingOff rewording („mozemy wzonowic…”, 588693a8 #1595).
- Recorded on the item with my concurrence. edfd applies holder note bca80c6d via revise.

3. Owner for the 11th C5 Medium
- w-54e15402ea0e goes to edfd, after its 3186 fix 7fc4a0dc.

23:28Z, Engram::Fable #7864: all 4 conditions ACCEPTED.
(1) Verified in 31c17d19: the only writer of CompletionReported is task_sync::reported::apply_on (reported.rs:138), called only from folder_admission.rs:854 (the task-sync folder import). Ordinary work words never emit it. Order stands.
(2) The event is created only in the importing host's local store; the exchange carries task text, not events. Still, no old-build host takes part in task-sync exchange until it carries the new build, and the Mac's Engram stays out of sync until then. 12325 will confirm that the exported document format is unchanged.
(3) Create-only dated backups under ~/.engram/backups on both hosts, with paths and hashes recorded.
(4) The sha256 and build_fingerprint per host come with "installed + ready".

01:44Z Nov 14, Engram::Fable #7867: baa6 candidate 31c17d19 will NOT land. 12325 is fixing an in-scope order-dependent fixture (corrections.rs:626, "prerequisites must be sorted and unique"), so the install at the held restart moves to the NEW candidate; its sha256 and fingerprint come later, at "installed + ready". The Engram Windows trio (w-ab27, w-a76f, w-728a) lands first as bf8ce052 on 75af1b27, after combo99c. The Merger's stall warnings are Engram's own code, filed as Engram w-710ef837c24b (P2). The 4 cutover conditions are unchanged.
